name: Christmas at the Mansion Open House at Museum of the Southwest
paras: The museum's annual open house brings Santa to the Midland campus for an afternoon, along with trains and trucks and the Southwest Express Train Depot. No reservation is needed and the event is open to the public.
A gingerbread workshop and cookies round out the visit. Families who want to build a house need to bring their own, though a cardboard version is sold in the gift shop while supplies last.
tip: Bring your own gingerbread house for the workshop, or buy a cardboard one in the gift shop early because supplies are limited.

name: The Nutcracker by Midland Festival Ballet
address: Wagner Noel Performing Arts Center, Midland, TX
ages: All ages, every patron needs a ticket
paras: Midland Festival Ballet stages its annual Nutcracker with more than 100 local dancers and live music from the West Texas Symphony. Guest artists from Dance Theatre of Harlem, Milwaukee Ballet and Orlando Ballet dance the Snow Queen, Sugar Plum Fairy and her Cavalier.
Two shows run on Saturday and one matinee on Sunday. Child, student, senior and group discounts of 10 percent apply to everything except premium seating.
tip: Every patron, including lap children and babies, needs a ticket, so count the whole family when you buy.
